name: Amazon Quick Sight
sku: Amazon Quick Sight, the BI feature inside Amazon Quick. Amazon Quick's AI agents, Flows, Automate, Index and Research are not scored.

serve.bi-viz.note: Interactive data visualisation and business intelligence: connect to data sources, build dashboards and embed analytics in applications. Amazon Quick evolved from QuickSight, and the QuickSight APIs continue to work.

proposed_capabilities.name: Natural-language access to data
proposed_capabilities.description: Asking questions of connected data in natural language and getting answers from AI agents, next to dashboards. Amazon Quick pairs Quick Sight with agents that work against connected data sources and applications.

presentation.tagline: Dashboards and embedded analytics inside Amazon Quick.
